I want to add large language model support to lunar_analyst.  The goal
of LLM support is to help the user use the tool.

* It must be able to carry out commands expressed in prose
* It must be able to describe the capabilites of the lunar_analyst tool.
* It must be able to describe products (geotiffs, plots, tables) generated by lunar_analyst or by scripts.

* There must be a new panel where the user can input a request
* There must be a new panel where the LLM can respond
* The capabilities of lunar_analyst will be exposed to the language model via an MCP interface
* Lunar_analyst must be capable of running a model locally on a laptop (a 5090 mobile GPU is available, although it is shared with lunar_analyst computation tasks).
* The local model can be run via ollama or by a python subprocess
* Lunar_analyst must be capable of using remote models served by openai, anthropic, google and other similar providers.
* When the model is run remotely, token caching must be enabled

If you have questions about these requirements, ask them.

Then consider these requirements and give me options for implementing them.

Questions

Question 1. Should prose commands that mutate state (launch jobs,
import files, move paths) require explicit user confirmation every
time?

Answer: Implement this the way you (codex) do.  Ask but provide an
option to allow subsequent actions of the same type.

Question 2. Is conversation history allowed to be persisted on disk,
or must it be memory-only per session?

It should be persisted to disk.  Provide a way to resume a session.
(Ideally a way to compact the context should be provided.)

Question 3. Do you want one “assistant” that can both chat and
execute, or a strict split (“chat mode” vs “execute mode”)?

One assistant that can do both.

Question 4. Which local model class should be baseline on the 5090
mobile GPU (small/fast vs larger/slower), and do you want automatic
fallback when GPU is busy?

I don't know what you mean by 'model class'.  The models locally
available now are: deepseek-coder-v2:16b, qwen3.5:35b-a3b,
qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct-q4_K_M, qwen2.5-coder:7b

However, please suggest more appropriate choices, if you have any.

Question 5. For remote providers, should credentials be per-user
session or global server config?

global server config

Question 6. Is MCP required only for internal tool exposure, or must
external MCP clients also connect to Lunar Analyst?

I want external LLM's to be able to drive Lunar Analyst via the MCP
interface.  I don't know whether there are external MCP clients (not
Lunar Analyst) that would be useful for the sort of analysis Lunar
Analyst is designed for.  If so, then yes, we want to be able to
connect to them.

I don't know enough about MCP architectures to know how this would
work or what the right design patterns are.
